bongo-rx-annual-replenishment-pack-extra.name: Bongo Rx Annual Replenishment Pack — Extra Large (XL)
bongo-rx-annual-replenishment-pack-extra.description: Annual replenishment pack: 4 × Extra Large (XL) Bongo Rx devices, with a headgear, travel case and drying stand. One order unit = one pack of 4.
features: No machine, no masks, no hoses and no power needed (manufacturer description)
Soft silicone sealing beads hold the device in the nostrils; one-way valves create expiratory back pressure (EPAP)
Manufacturer statement: reviewed and cleared by the FDA for the treatment of mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea
Quiet — allows sleeping in virtually any position
Reusable and easy to clean; small enough to fit in a pocket
Designed and made in the USA
Prescription device
